title: A user with only the View permission can open the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY) is a staff member at {Location-A} whose custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY) has only 'Part Library & Inventory → View' in the Parts department.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser or a private window.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-VIEWONLY-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL VIEWONLY PART A), is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is inactive.
custom_steps:
1. As {User-B}, go to Parts → Inventory.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Search {Part-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The Inventory list opens on the Active tab, with the Inactive tab beside it.
  • Step 2: The Inactive tab opens.
  • Step 3: {Part-A} is listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-N1, S1-R2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.5 (The Inactive tab, shown for an Admin), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-N1: “A user who can view the Inventory list can open the Inactive tab. Seeing inactive parts needs no extra permission.”
  • S1-R2: “Active is the selected tab when the page opens.”
